cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz && git show e53206271db4a83834433ab5f82d16815a18b998:test/fuzzing/fonts/clusterfuzz-testcase-minimized-hb-shape-fuzzer-5719982789361664 > /workspace/poc && ls -l /workspace/poc && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc').read_bytes()
print(p[:64].hex(), len(p))
try:
 from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
 f=TTFont('/workspace/poc', recalcBBoxes=False, recalcTimestamp=False)
 print(f.keys())
 for tag in f.keys():
  try:
   data=f.reader[tag]
   print(tag, 'offset', data.offset, 'len', data.length)
  except Exception as e: print(tag,e)
 print('numGlyphs', f['maxp'].numGlyphs if 'maxp' in f else None)
 print('hhea numMetrics', f['hhea'].numberOfHMetrics if 'hhea' in f else None)
 if 'hmtx' in f: print('hmtx metrics count maybe', len(f['hmtx'].metrics))
except Exception as e:

 print('fonttools err', type(e), e)
